Bradley, Hadrian, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco: not reached before the search cap

BBB: blocked (403). Section 10 Inc. was seen only through a search summary.

WebSearch: all 8 used. Queries: Division 10 Richmond; Chesterfield/Henrico installers; Section 10 Midlothian; Eastern Partitions; Division 10 Virginia cities; bathroom partition installers Richmond; Hampton Roads/Charlottesville/Fredericksburg; Barranger. Results were dominated by onepointpartitions.com, an online supplier with a Richmond delivery terminal that doesn't install, so it was skipped.

Excluded after reading: Kelley Bros (no Virginia office), Unified Door & Hardware Group / UDH (NJ, no Virginia mention), Martin Bros (California), Newton Distributing (MA, refers installers only), Frank M. Waters (MD/DC region, Virginia service not confirmed)

candidates.name: Barranger & Company, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage says it supplies and installs folding doors, partitions, toilet accessories and lockers; toilet partitions page has a gallery of installed stalls and urinal screens (e.g. Genworth project photos); about page: toilet compartments 'new, replace existing, refurnish or repair existing'.
candidates.reason: Richmond-based specialty-products distributor (50+ years) that supplies and installs toilet partitions for commercial, school, church and hospitality clients. Strong installer, but it is itself a partition dealer, so a real buy-around risk.
red_flags: Sells toilet partitions itself (Bobrick, Scranton, Global, etc.): direct competitor and buy-around risk

license.name: Barranger & Company, Inc.

license.note: The DPOR lookup needs a reCAPTCHA, so check by hand. Richmond asks for proof of Virginia licensure plus a business license (required above $25,000 a year in city revenue). The city record was not checked online. Checked 2026-11-19.
